PRODUCT: varG is an Ambler class B metallo-beta-lactamase found on the antibiotic resistance var regulon in Vibrio cholerae along with an antibiotic efflux pump varABCDEF. These genes are organized as a regulon under the control of VarR transcriptional activator. VarG was shown to have beta-lactamase activity against penicillins carbapenems and cephalosporins in-vitro. Described by Lin HV et al. 2017.
A member of the AlmEFG operon responsible for polymyxin resistance in Vibrio cholerae. AlmG is a glycyltransferase closely related to lipid A acyltransferases. Described by Henderson JC et al. 2017.
almF is a glycine carrier protein associated with the almEFG operon in Vibrio cholerae. It is activated by almE and carries the glycyl molecule later added to lipid A by almG.
almE is a glycyltransferase found in Vibrio cholerae that transfers glycine to the carrier protein almF. almE is part of the almEFG polymyxin resistance operon.
dfrA1 is an integron-encoded dihydrofolate reductase.
Sul2 is a sulfonamide resistant dihydropteroate synthase of Gram-negative bacteria usually found on small plasmids.
APH(3'')-Ib is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids transposons integrative conjugative elements and chromosomes in Enterobacteriaceae and Pseudomonas spp.

APH(6)-Id is an aminoglycoside phosphotransferase encoded by plasmids integrative conjugative elements and chromosomal genomic islands in K. pneumoniae Salmonella spp. E. coli Shigella flexneri Providencia alcalifaciens Pseudomonas spp. V. cholerae Edwardsiella tarda Pasteurella multocida and Aeromonas bestiarum.
Tet(59) is a chromosome-encoded tetracycline efflux pump described from a Chinese pig manure sample.
catB9 is a chromosome-encoded variant of the cat gene found in Vibrio cholerae.
QnrVC1 is an integron-mediated quinolone resistance protein found in Vibrio cholerae.
dfrA31 is an antibiotic resistance dihydrofolate reductase from an integron found from Vibrio cholerae.
